aiOverview.content: Rory McIlroy’s caddie is Harry Diamond, a close childhood friend and former elite amateur golfer from Northern Ireland who has been on his bag since 2017. Diamond is credited with providing a calming influence and close friendship that helps McIlroy manage pressure, making him an integral part of his team.This video explains how Rory McIlroy and his caddie, Harry Diamond, make their player-caddie relationship work:01:43How Leaders Lead with David NovakYouTube• Apr 23, 2025Key details about Harry Diamond:Background: Born in Holywood, Northern Ireland, he met McIlroy at a local golf club as a child and won the 2012 West of Ireland Championship.Partnership: He became McIlroy’s full-time caddie in 2017 after previously taking time off in 2019.Success: Diamond has been on the bag for multiple major wins, including the 2025 Masters and numerous PGA Tour victories.Relationship: McIlroy describes him as a "big brother" figure and trust his honest feedback, especially during high-stakes events like the Masters.This video shows Rory McIlroy's perspective on his long-term friendship and working relationship with Harry Diamond:01:05CBS SportsYouTube• Apr 13, 2025Note: In rare instances, such as in 2019, Diamond has taken breaks to be with his family, with Niall O'Connor filling in, but he remains McIlroy's primary caddie.
